title: Package and CLI versions have independent sources of truth
reasoning: Distribution metadata is versioned in pyproject.toml while the --version command reads a separate literal from __init__.py. They currently match, but either can be updated independently, allowing a published wheel and its executable to report different versions.
reproduction: Change only project.version, build/install the package, and compare package metadata with clawpatch-supervise --version.
recommendation: Use one authoritative version source, such as importlib.metadata for the CLI or setuptools dynamic versioning from the package attribute.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: None of the included tests compare project metadata, the package attribute, and CLI output.
suggestedRegressionTest: Assert that importlib.metadata.version('clawpatch-supervise'), clawpatch_supervise.__version__, and --version agree in an installed-package test.
minimumFixScope: Consolidate version lookup in __init__.py or clawpatch_external.py and add one release-version consistency test.
